wall2_selection.finding: OH libhmicuuc.z.so (mapped in the app process, U12 maps-t5) reads /system/usr/icu and needs ICU 74 (icudt74l, u_setDataDirectory_74). It shares /system/usr/icu with tttext.
wall2_selection.option_a_rejected: per-app remap of /system/usr/icu to ICU-72 would feed icudt72l to OH libhmicuuc (needs 74) -> breaks OH ICU in-process.
wall2_selection.chosen: option (b): add _74 alias exports to Android libicuuc.so (aliases of _72). Set = ubrk_open/close/first/next/setText, u_charType, u_hasBinaryProperty.
wall2_selection.b_collision_safe: Adding _74 aliases does NOT collide with OH libhmicuuc's real _74: Android libicuuc is RTLD_LOCAL (runtime westlake_icu_overrides; tttext via ANL_Dlopen which forbids RTLD_GLOBAL) and lives in child namespaces (westlake.sealed.child / westlake.anl.app); OH resolves its _74 in DEFAULT via its direct NEEDED libhmicuuc; default does not inherit from child namespaces, and RTLD_LOCAL keeps Android libicuuc out of global scope. tttext's dlsym searches only its own libicuuc handle graph. So the alias is reachable only by tttext, never OH.
wall2_selection.b_prime_fallback: if that isolation were ever broken, ship an app-ns-only shim named libicuuc.so (shadows the soname for the app ns), exporting only the _74 names forwarding to the Android _72.
